title: SMS, automatic replies and in-call texting

rules.text: In-call texting requires incall_sms_enabled on the agent, an SMS-capable business number and valid carrier credentials. Inbound sends from the dialled number to its caller. Outbound sends from the originating number to the person called. Respect opt-outs on both paths. Never substitute another tenant’s sender.
rules.why: The call and its business number determine the SMS sender.

rules.text: SMS does not automatically inherit the inbound phone profile.
rules.instead: Put this business’s SMS instructions in sms_prompt and configure automatic replies for its number.

rules.text: A single text, an automatic conversation reply and a call-triggered text are separate sends. Keep each message’s sender, receipt and consent together.
Choose sms_reply_enabled and sms_prompt for this number. Keep business-specific details separate when numbers share an agent.
A send requires an eligible number and the account’s contact permissions. Individual switches cannot bypass a STOP.
Use the single-message endpoint for an intentional send from the verified business number.
sms_outcome_unknown means delivery could not be confirmed. Check the receipt and history before another send.
